# WIRED
> WIRED covers the latest in technology, science, culture, business, security, and gear through reporting, analysis, reviews, and features.

WIRED is a long-running digital magazine and news publication focused on how technology shapes the world. Its site combines breaking news, investigative reporting, product reviews, opinion, podcasts, videos, newsletters, and magazine features across consumer tech, AI, cybersecurity, politics, transportation, health, and culture.

## Main Hubs
- [Home](https://www.wired.com/): Front page for WIRED’s latest stories across technology, science, culture, and business.
- [Magazine](https://www.wired.com/magazine/): Digital magazine hub for features, essays, and long-form reporting.
- [Latest](https://www.wired.com/latest/): Reverse-chronological feed of newly published WIRED stories.
- [Most Recent](https://www.wired.com/most-recent/): Continuously updated stream of recent articles and posts.
- [Video](https://www.wired.com/video/): Video hub for interviews, explainers, documentaries, and recurring series.
- [Podcasts](https://www.wired.com/podcasts/): Central page for WIRED audio shows and podcast episodes.
- [Newsletters](https://www.wired.com/newsletters/): Newsletter signup hub for editorial roundups and topic-specific updates.

## Technology
- [Business](https://www.wired.com/category/business/): Coverage of tech companies, startups, platforms, labor, and digital markets.
- [Security](https://www.wired.com/category/security/): Reporting on cybersecurity, privacy, surveillance, hacking, and national security.
- [Politics](https://www.wired.com/category/politics/): Stories on policy, regulation, elections, and the political impact of technology.
- [Ideas](https://www.wired.com/category/ideas/): Essays, arguments, and expert perspectives on technology and society.
- [Backchannel](https://www.wired.com/tag/backchannel/): Analysis and features on power, platforms, and the tech industry.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.wired.com/tag/artificial-intelligence/): Reporting on AI models, companies, policy, and real-world impacts.

## Science
- [Science](https://www.wired.com/category/science/): Coverage of research, space, climate, biology, and scientific discovery.
- [Space](https://www.wired.com/tag/space/): News and features on astronomy, rockets, satellites, and exploration.
- [Climate](https://www.wired.com/tag/climate/): Reporting on climate science, energy, adaptation, and environmental policy.
- [Health](https://www.wired.com/category/science/): Science reporting frequently includes medicine, public health, and biotech topics.
- [Biotech](https://www.wired.com/tag/biotechnology/): Stories on genetics, bioengineering, pharmaceuticals, and medical innovation.
- [Robots](https://www.wired.com/tag/robots/): Coverage of robotics research, automation, and machine intelligence.

## Culture
- [Culture](https://www.wired.com/category/culture/): Coverage of entertainment, internet culture, media, and digital life.
- [Gear](https://www.wired.com/category/gear/): Product news, buying advice, and reviews for consumer technology.
- [Reviews](https://www.wired.com/category/gear/reviews/): Tested reviews of phones, laptops, wearables, and other gadgets.
- [Shopping](https://www.wired.com/category/gear/shopping/): Buying guides, deals coverage, and recommendations for consumer tech.
- [Games](https://www.wired.com/tag/games/): Reporting on video games, game culture, and the gaming industry.
- [Social Media](https://www.wired.com/tag/social-media/): Stories on platforms, creators, moderation, and online communities.

## Gear and Buying Guides
- [Gear Home](https://www.wired.com/category/gear/): Main destination for product coverage, reviews, and recommendations.
- [Product Reviews](https://www.wired.com/category/gear/reviews/): Hands-on evaluations of gadgets, accessories, and connected devices.
- [Buying Guides](https://www.wired.com/category/gear/shopping/): Curated guides to the best products in major consumer tech categories.
- [Phones](https://www.wired.com/tag/phones/): Coverage and reviews of smartphones, accessories, and mobile ecosystems.
- [Laptops](https://www.wired.com/tag/laptops/): Reviews and recommendations for notebooks and portable computers.
- [Electric Bikes](https://www.wired.com/tag/electric-bikes/): Reviews and reporting on ebikes, mobility, and urban transportation gear.
- [Wearables](https://www.wired.com/tag/wearables/): Coverage of smartwatches, fitness trackers, and health-focused devices.

## Security and Privacy
- [Security](https://www.wired.com/category/security/): Core security desk covering breaches, malware, cyberwar, and digital defense.
- [Privacy](https://www.wired.com/tag/privacy/): Reporting on data collection, consumer privacy, and platform practices.
- [Surveillance](https://www.wired.com/tag/surveillance/): Coverage of monitoring technologies used by governments and companies.
- [Hacking](https://www.wired.com/tag/hacking/): Stories on hackers, exploits, vulnerabilities, and security research.
- [Encryption](https://www.wired.com/tag/encryption/): Reporting on secure communications, cryptography, and policy debates.
- [National Security](https://www.wired.com/tag/national-security/): Coverage of intelligence, cyber conflict, and state security issues.

## Business and Policy
- [Business](https://www.wired.com/category/business/): Reporting on markets, platforms, labor, venture capital, and tech economics.
- [Politics](https://www.wired.com/category/politics/): Coverage of legislation, regulators, elections, and governance.
- [Silicon Valley](https://www.wired.com/tag/silicon-valley/): Stories on major tech firms, founders, and startup culture.
- [Big Tech](https://www.wired.com/tag/big-tech/): Reporting on dominant technology companies and their influence.
- [Antitrust](https://www.wired.com/tag/antitrust/): Coverage of competition policy, lawsuits, and regulatory enforcement.
- [Labor](https://www.wired.com/tag/labor/): Stories on workers, unions, gig platforms, and workplace technology.

## Transportation and Energy
- [Transportation](https://www.wired.com/tag/transportation/): Coverage of mobility, infrastructure, logistics, and future transit.
- [Electric Vehicles](https://www.wired.com/tag/electric-vehicles/): Reporting on EVs, charging, automakers, and battery technology.
- [Cars](https://www.wired.com/tag/cars/): Reviews and reporting on automobiles, software, and vehicle design.
- [Autonomous Vehicles](https://www.wired.com/tag/autonomous-vehicles/): Coverage of self-driving technology, regulation, and deployment.
- [Energy](https://www.wired.com/tag/energy/): Stories on power systems, renewables, grids, and energy markets.
- [Batteries](https://www.wired.com/tag/batteries/): Reporting on battery science, manufacturing, and storage technologies.

## Multimedia
- [Video](https://www.wired.com/video/): WIRED’s video library of interviews, explainers, and documentary-style features.
- [Podcasts](https://www.wired.com/podcasts/): Hub for WIRED podcasts covering tech, politics, and internet culture.
- [The Big Interview](https://www.wired.com/tag/the-big-interview/): Interview series featuring prominent figures in technology and culture.
- [Uncanny Valley](https://www.wired.com/tag/uncanny-valley/): Podcast and coverage focused on AI, internet culture, and tech news.
- [Plaintext](https://www.wired.com/tag/plaintext/): WIRED coverage and commentary associated with digital culture and platforms.
- [Photo](https://www.wired.com/tag/photography/): Visual storytelling and photography-related features and coverage.

## Newsletters and Subscription
- [Newsletters](https://www.wired.com/newsletters/): Signup page for WIRED newsletters across major editorial beats.
- [Subscribe](https://subscribe.wired.com/): Subscription offers for WIRED digital and print access.
- [Magazine Customer Care](https://www.wired.com/customerservice): Customer service information for subscriptions and account support.
- [Archive](https://www.wired.com/magazine/): Access point for magazine-style features and issue-oriented editorial content.
- [Gift Subscriptions](https://subscribe.wired.com/subscribe/splits/wired/WIR_GIFT): Gift subscription purchase page for WIRED.
- [Manage Account](https://www.wired.com/account): Account access for subscribers and registered users.

## About and Contact
- [About WIRED](https://www.wired.com/about/): Information about WIRED’s mission, editorial focus, and publication identity.
- [Contact Us](https://www.wired.com/about/contact-us/): Contact information for editorial, tips, and general inquiries.
- [Masthead](https://www.wired.com/about/masthead/): Editorial leadership, contributors, and publication staff listing.
- [Press Center](https://www.wired.com/about/press-center/): Press resources and media contact information.
- [Accessibility Help](https://www.wired.com/about/accessibility-help/): Accessibility support information for using WIRED’s site and content.
- [RSS Feeds](https://www.wired.com/feed/rss): RSS feed access for following WIRED content updates.
